Creative Director OR ACD OR Product Design Lead OR AI Creative Lead OR CRM Creative Director — US Remote 24h

jobs.title: Vice President of Brand & Creative
jobs.why: VP Brand & Creative at Proper Hospitality (design-forward boutique hotels, $235k-255k, LA-based) is a senior creative leadership role with direct C-suite partnership. Garman's brand systems thinking, visual identity work, and ability to lead creative organizations map well. Hospitality is a new domain, and VP title is an ambitious step up, but the brief matches his profile: own the brand standard, lead creative team, scale a function.

jobs.title: Director, Catalog Creative
jobs.why: Director Catalog Creative at UMG/Capitol (West Hollywood) oversees visual media and brand identity systems for iconic catalog artists—reissues, anniversary campaigns, archival storytelling. Garman's brand systems and campaign design map well, and UMG is a major entertainment brand. Risk: music industry is a new domain and catalog creative is specialized (working with archival/legacy material rather than new launches).

jobs.title: Athleta Head of Creative, Athleta
jobs.why: Head of Creative at Athleta (Gap brand) reports to CMO, owns brand visual identity and storytelling across all touchpoints—exactly Garman's strength in brand systems and campaign direction. Strong brand and creative leadership fit. Key risks: posted as New York location (despite appearing in remote search), and consumer athletic apparel is a domain stretch from automotive/tech.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, UX Design, Prime Video User Experience Design
jobs.why: Sr. Manager UX Design at Prime Video is a people-management design director role at Amazon, owning end-to-end product experience for a global streaming service. Garman's product design range (Storyfire, Toyota Garage, Mr. Cooper) and mentorship history map well. Risk: purely product UX without brand creative angle.

jobs.title: Product Design Manager, Adobe Experience Platform
jobs.why: Product Design Manager at Adobe Experience Platform is a strong company (Adobe) but the role focuses on enterprise data tooling (audience segmentation), is based in SF, and is primarily people management over craft leadership. Adobe's design culture is excellent but this specific product team is far from brand creative work.

jobs.title: Sr. Lead, Creative Advertising, Amazon Prime Video Studios Marketing
jobs.why: Sr. Lead Creative Advertising at Amazon Prime Video is director-level work—360 campaign ideation, team management, AV/print/social. Strong fit on creative leadership and brand storytelling, but the role explicitly requires entertainment marketing (film/TV campaign) experience that Garman lacks. His Disney Habit Heroes and PlayStation work is adjacent but not direct. Below threshold.

jobs.title: Director, Product Design
jobs.why: Director Product Design at Oscar Health is a clear director title, but the role focuses on internal enterprise tools—not consumer-facing or brand creative. Health insurance domain is new for Garman and the creative brand storytelling strength gets little leverage here.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.why: Director of Product Design at Hiive (FinTech private markets) offers a clear director title and startup equity upside. Garman's Mr. Cooper and Xome work shows FinTech product design experience, but the domain is highly specialized and the company is small with limited brand recognition.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer, Spark
jobs.why: Lead Product Designer at Lightspark is well-compensated ($200k-235k) but deeply embedded in crypto/Bitcoin L2 infrastructure. The product is highly technical, purely product (no brand creative), and Garman has no crypto domain experience. Poor positioning fit.
